$comment: Skill inventory for the Jev skill router. Scanned 2026-09-21.

skills.name: sitrep
skills.description: Morning briefing or mid-day catch-up. Synthesizes radar, inbox, handoff, git, PRs, and prod health into one prioritized view.

skills.name: sprint
skills.description: Sprint planning and refinement. Pull tickets, cross-reference OKRs, score on risk/value/urgency/customer-impact, produce prioritised artifact.

skills.name: inbox
skills.description: ELMO Inbox operating system — smart priority, capture, reconciliation, 1:1 prep, standup, and weekly review over Obsidian vault.

skills.name: breakdown
skills.description: Initiative work decomposition — T-shirt sizing, dependency graphs, sprint slicing, and feasibility verdicts.

skills.name: tone-of-voice
skills.description: Rewrites messages in Eugene's voice — friendly, plain-spoken technical leadership. For PRs, Jira tickets, Slack, emails, docs.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts token usage ~75% while keeping full technical accuracy.

skills.name: caveman-review
skills.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. One line per comment: location, problem, fix.

skills.name: caveman-commit
skills.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Conventional Commits, subject ≤50 chars.

skills.name: eff-review
skills.description: Review an Elmo frontend PR, branch, or diff. Audits against @eds/@eff patterns and Elmo workspace conventions.

skills.name: eff-designreview
skills.description: Designer's expert pass on a running page. Screenshots at 3 viewports + DOM scan, reviewed against 8 design dimensions.

skills.name: eds-tokens
skills.description: ELMO Design System (EDS4) complete reference. Token values, @eds/react component library, Figma specs, import paths.

skills.name: design-prototype
skills.description: Build page prototypes for non-frontend contributors. React pages using @eds/react + @eff/components with mock data.

skills.name: elmo-application-frontend
skills.description: Elmo frontend orientation — architecture tiers, permissions, tooling, testing, module boundaries, Nx monorepo.

skills.name: figma-eds-audit
skills.description: Audits a Figma design frame for ELMO Design System component coverage. Classifies nodes as EDS or non-EDS.

skills.name: figma-mcp-workflow
skills.description: Operational runbook for Figma MCP read AND write operations. Rendering, font loading, dual-frame workflow.

skills.name: ui-implementation-audit
skills.description: Converts Figma frames and ticket context into an execution-grade UI Implementation Brief with TDD scope.

skills.name: kibana
skills.description: Query Elasticsearch for frontend errors, backend exceptions, and application logs. Investigate production issues.

skills.name: launchdarkly
skills.description: Manage LaunchDarkly feature flags — list, inspect, toggle, and update flags across projects and environments.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Release prep: changelog scan, risk assessment, dependency check, lint, test coverage, Slack-ready summary with rollback plan.

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.description: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files for visualizing workflows, architectures, or concepts.

skills.name: flowmo
skills.description: Flowmo SDLC orchestrator entry point. Routes to requirements, delivery, project, initiative, verify, or catalogue sub-skills.

skills.name: flowmo-requirements
skills.description: PO-facing requirements authoring: Features + Slices with Figma links and given/when/then ACs. Publishes to Jira.

skills.name: flowmo-delivery
skills.description: Developer-facing implementation orchestrator: pick up a Jira ticket and orchestrate across BE/FE/EDS repos.

skills.name: flowmo-verify
skills.description: Verify ticket claims against legacy/new code and Figma, or staging-audit the live deployed feature.

skills.name: flowmo-project
skills.description: Project-level oversight: init, update, assess health, audit requirements coverage across themes.

skills.name: flowmo-initiative
skills.description: PM-facing Phase 0 Discovery: customer data synthesis (Gong, Zendesk, Pendo), Opportunity Canvas, BRICE scoring.

skills.name: flowmo-catalogue
skills.description: Requirements bootstrap: capture an existing module's complete functional behaviour as a requirements catalogue.

skills.name: rg-mobile
skills.description: Rotageek React Native repo operating guide: runtime, navigation, auth, GraphQL/codegen, native builds, testing.

skills.name: mobile-tooling
skills.description: Collection of tooling skills for React Native mobile work. Packaged for consuming repos.

skills.name: react-native-module-federation
skills.description: Architect, implement, migrate, and debug React Native microfrontends using Re.Pack, Module Federation 2.0, and Metro plugin.

skills.name: flowmo-mobile
skills.description: Install-by-module umbrella for the ELMO HR mobile team. Ships flowmo spine plus mobile code guide.

skills.name: cobra
skills.description: Cobra codebase orientation — BFF proxy, upstream resolver, cobra app, cobra proxy.

skills.name: identity
skills.description: Kong OIDC, Kong gateway, oidc-multitenant plugin, auth and identity infrastructure.

skills.name: design-spec
skills.description: Specification-driven design skills. Covers design handoff: annotating designs, mapping interaction flows, pre-dev checklist.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description: EDS maintenance skills — token sync, component specs, Figma Code Connect, coverage audits.

skills.name: eff
skills.description: Elmo Frontend Design — the Elmo flavour of frontend design patterns.

skills.name: elmo-eds
skills.description: ELMO Design System (@eds/react) — three coupled skills inside a single plugin.

skills.name: ld-audit
skills.description: LaunchDarkly flag retirement audit for a code repo. Given a team, finds stale/unused flags.

skills.name: learning-dev
skills.description: Skills for the ELMO Learning team — biases changes toward small, safe, tested increments.

skills.name: platform-mcps
skills.description: Token-budget controls, playbooks, and operating rules for all ELMO MCP servers routed via agentgateway.

skills.name: skill-review
skills.description: Adversarial review for repos whose product is instructions — skills, agent contracts, reference docs.

skills.name: ui-design
skills.description: UI design skills for ELMO product teams with Figma MCP direct write access. Covers web and mobile platforms.

skills.name: keep-alive
skills.description: Prevents host sleep/lock during long-running processes. Surfaces 'waiting for permission' status in a local browser dashboard.

skills.name: sense-check
skills.description: Sanity-check, double-check, or verify the previous answer before relying on it.

skills.name: feature-qa-autopilot
skills.description: Autonomous end-to-end QA for an in-flight feature/epic across backend and frontend. Drives Playwright, fixes bugs, records Jira evidence.

skills.name: implement-ticket
skills.description: Take a Jira ticket from spec to PR. Fetches ticket, plans, creates branch, implements, tests, opens PR, transitions Jira.

skills.name: elmo-nodejs-kafka-sink
skills.description: Skills for @elmo/kafka-sink-core — consumer scaffolding, transformers, tenant resolution, SDK events, batch tuning, releases.

skills.name: flowmo-recruitment
skills.description: Install-by-module umbrella for the Recruitment team. Flowmo SDLC + recruitment-specific overrides.

skills.name: speckit-specify
skills.description: Create or update feature specification from natural language description.

skills.name: speckit-plan
skills.description: Execute implementation planning workflow using plan template to generate design artifacts.

skills.name: speckit-implement
skills.description: Execute implementation plan by processing all tasks defined in tasks.md.
